caption: Five practical AI prompts for everyday tasks. Give the AI useful context, check the answer, and adapt it to your needs. Save these for later. #AI #AITips #Productivity

slides.title: Stop giving AI vague instructions.
slides.body:
Better answers start with a better brief.

Here are 5 practical prompts you can copy and try today.

slides.title: 1. Turn a messy list into a plan
slides.body: “Organise these tasks by deadline and importance. Suggest a realistic order and flag anything that needs more information. Tasks: [paste your list].”

slides.title: 2. Understand something unfamiliar
slides.body: “Explain [topic] in plain English. Give one everyday example, then ask me three questions to check my understanding. Flag anything uncertain.”

slides.title: 3. Make your writing clearer
slides.body: “Edit this draft for clarity while keeping my tone. Do not add facts. Show the revised version and explain your three most useful changes. Draft: [paste].”

slides.title: 4. Compare your options
slides.body: “Compare [option A] and [option B] against these criteria: [list]. Use only the information below. Mark missing details instead of guessing. Information: [paste].”

slides.title: 5. Practise a conversation
slides.body: “Role-play [situation] with me. Ask one question at a time. After five exchanges, give specific feedback on how clearly I communicated.”

slides.title: Try one. Check the result.
slides.body:
Pick one prompt.
Add your own context.
Check the answer.

Save these prompts for the next time you use AI.
